import fasttext, os, time

# Train high-dim model for accuracy, then quantize to reduce size
t0=time.time()
model = fasttext.train_supervised(
    input='/tmp/train_ft_lower.txt',
    epoch=10,
    lr=0.5,
    wordNgrams=2,
    dim=200,
    bucket=200000,
    minCount=2,
    thread=4,
    verbose=2
)

# Evaluate before quantization
result = model.test('/tmp/test_ft_lower.txt')

# Save unquantized for reference

# Quantize with retrain, using test as validation
model.quantize(input='/tmp/train_ft_lower.txt', retrain=True, cutoff=100000, qnorm=True, thread=4, verbose=2)
result_q = model.test('/tmp/test_ft_lower.txt')
print('After quant Test N@1:', result_q)

model.save_model('/app/model.bin')
